data.body:
Implementation landed locally on branch s2-docker-disk-cap.

Design as reviewed: one /var/lib/docker budget (20 GiB, 5 GiB BuildKit share) in the new infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh, with three honestly-unequal enforcement strengths — daemon builder.gc for BuildKit, retention for the image/layer share, and ALARM-ONLY for orphaned overlay2, which no cap or prune can reach.

The crux: observability.sh 2f takes two independent measurements of the same bytes — du -sx over /var/lib/docker and .../overlay2 (filesystem truth) and docker system df (the daemon's ledger) — and publishes their difference as docker_unaccounted_bytes. A test replays the incident shape (16 GiB overlay2 vs a 9.529GB ledger) and asserts the ~6.6 GiB residue surfaces.

Three alarms: rebar-docker-storage-cap-high, rebar-docker-buildkit-cache-high, rebar-docker-unaccounted-overlay2 — all 300/3/2, treat_missing_data=breaching, SNS-wired, pinned by name in test_alarm_actions_terraform.py (floors 21->24, 16->19, 15->18).

Also corrected in passing (an ADR 0112 consequence): rebar-root-disk-pressure's description still said '30G ROOT disk' against a 60 GiB volume, and now points readers at the per-generator alarms first.

Terraform was written and validated only (fmt -check clean, validate Success). NOTHING was applied.

make lint, make typecheck, terraform fmt/validate, the mechanism-delta and complexity ratchets, and all affected tests pass. Note: tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_a_marker_in_a_new_gate_scripts_head_admits_it fails identically on a pristine origin/main worktree on this host (ModuleNotFoundError: scripts._mechanism_delta) — pre-existing, not from this change.
